Important details are buried within a day, so players ask the same questions every week: when is practice, where is qualifying, am I traveling. Parents can't easily find where the next tournament is or how to follow live scoring. Recruits email the coach for basic information and results. The official athletics site has results, but someone outside the team updates it, sometimes days late, and it says nothing about practice or travel.\n\nThe coach, captain and team manager are not technical. The coach doesn't want to learn new software mid-season. Some content has to be protected: only the coach may change the travel lineup and qualifying results, only the coach may edit the recruiting page (NCAA rules), and editors must never delete past results.\n\n## Solution\n\nA small CMS for the team. Content is written on **the team laptop** in a local admin console, and a static public site, built for phones first, is updated on GitHub Pages.\n\n- The **Coach** (admin) owns every **page** (Season Schedule, Travel Lineup, Recruiting) and every **qualifying result**, and manages **accounts**.\n- The **Captain** and **Team manager** (editors) write **posts**: the weekly **practice schedule** and **tournament recaps**. They can change only their own posts.\n- Publishing is one click. Any change to published content triggers a **site update**: the public site is rebuilt and deployed automatically (ADR-004). If the deploy fails, the change is not saved, so the console and the website always agree.\n- A **reader** opens the home page on their phone and sees the Travel Lineup, then the newest posts (including this week's practice schedule). The nav links to every page.\n\nVocabulary follows `CONTEXT.md`.\n\n## User Stories\n\n### Login and accounts\n1. As the Coach, I want to log in with my email and password, so that only I can reach the coach-only parts of the console.\n2. As the Captain, I want to log in with my own account, so that my posts carry my name.\n3. As any account holder, I want to log out, so that the next person on the team laptop can't post as me.\n4. As the Coach, I want passwords stored only as argon2 hashes, so that a copied database doesn't reveal anyone's password.\n5. As any account holder, I want a wrong password to give a generic error, so that nobody can tell which emails have accounts.\n6. As a reader or someone who isn't logged in, I want every console URL to send me to the login page, so that the console is never usable without an account.\n7. As the Coach, I want to create an account for this season's Captain with the editor role, so that they can post the practice schedule.\n8. As the Coach, I want to create an account for this season's Team manager with the editor role, so that they can write recaps.\n9. As the Coach, I want to change an account's role, so that I can correct a role given by mistake.\n10. As the Coach, I want to deactivate a graduated Captain's account, so that they can no longer log in.\n11. As a deactivated Captain, I am refused at login even with the right password, so that former team members can't post.\n12. As the Coach, I want a deactivated account's published posts to stay on the site under its name, so that last season's record isn't lost.\n13. As an admin, I am prevented from deactivating my own account, so that the site always keeps an admin.\n14. As the Webmaster, I want a backup admin account, so that I can recover the site if the Coach is locked out.\n15. As an editor, I am refused the account-management screens, including by typing the URL directly, so that only admins manage accounts (field notes: WordPress hid Users *and* denied the direct link).\n\n### Posts\n16. As the Captain, I want to write a practice schedule post with a title and a Markdown body, so that I can format times and places as a list.\n17. As the Captain, I want to save a post as a draft, so that I can finish it later without anyone seeing it.\n18. As the Captain, I want to publish my post with one click, next to Save draft, so that publishing isn't a two-step chore (field notes).\n19. As the Captain, I want the slug generated from the title and made unique automatically (practice-schedule, practice-schedule-2, …), so that I never have to type or think about a slug.\n20. As an admin, I want to edit a slug if needed, so that an important post can have a clean URL.\n21. As the Team manager, I want to write a tournament recap (text only), so that alumni and parents know how the team did.\n22. As the Coach, I want to post qualifying results, so that players and recruits can see them.\n23. As an editor, I want to edit and delete only my own posts, so that the Captain can't change the Coach's results and the Team manager can't change the practice schedule.\n24. As an editor, I am refused when I try to edit or delete someone else's post, even through a direct request, so that the rule holds when the button is hidden.\n25. As the Coach, I want to edit or delete any post, so that I can correct mistakes or remove a botched result.\n26. As any author, I want each post to show its author and its created and updated times, so that readers know how current it is.\n27. As an editor, I want to unpublish my own post, so that I can take down something posted by mistake.\n\n### Pages\n28. As the Coach, I want to create and edit the Season Schedule page, including live-scoring links, so that parents know where the next tournament is and how to follow it.\n29. As the Coach, I want to update the Travel Lineup page in place once, so that I stop texting it to eight people.\n30. As the Coach, I want to edit the Recruiting page with my contact details, so that recruits can reach me without emailing for basics, and so that its content stays NCAA-compliant.\n31. As an editor, I am refused all page creation, editing and deletion, so that every coach-only page is protected by one simple rule.\n32. As a reader, I want every published page in the site navigation, so that I can find the schedule, lineup and recruiting info from any page.\n33. As the Coach, I want draft pages to stay out of the navigation, so that a half-written page never shows up.\n\n### Admin console\n34. As the Coach, I want a dashboard with counts of posts and pages by status, so that I can see what's in draft at a glance.\n35. As any account holder, I want posts and pages in one content list, so that I don't have to hunt for separate menus (field notes).\n36. As the Coach, I want the site to update automatically whenever I publish, edit, unpublish or delete published content, so that I never have to remember a second button.\n41. As a player, I want the home page to show the Travel Lineup first and then the newest posts, so that one page on my phone answers \"am I traveling\" and \"when is practice\".\n44. {"parentUuid":"cc6e03bb-670c-4d5e-b16c-28de31234dcc","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"ccfe1af8-1b6f-4bbb-ae51-d4f32feec672","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01CyNrt5Si8A8AtaDW3Uv5rz","type":"tool_result","content":".claude/hooks/ctx_compact_log.py\n.claude/hooks/ctx_guard.py\n.claude/hooks/ctx_statusline.py\n.claude/hooks/save_transcript.py\n.claude/settings.json\n.claude/skills/PINNED.md\n.env.example\n.gitignore\nAGENTS.md\nCLAUDE.md\nCONTEXT.md\nREADME.md\nSECURITY-CHECKLIST.md\napp/__init__.py\napp/accounts.py\napp/cli.py\napp/content.py\napp/db.py\napp/main.py\napp/markdown.py\napp/publish.py\napp/routes/__init__.py\napp/routes/accounts.py\napp/routes/auth.py\napp/routes/console.py\napp/routes/posts.py\napp/seed.py\napp/settings.py\napp/web.py\ndev/manual_setup_20260922.md\ndocs/adr/ADR-001-local-admin-static-public.md\ndocs/adr/ADR-002-stack.md\ndocs/adr/ADR-003-stop-hook-reads-transcript.md\ndocs/adr/ADR-004-publish-auto-deploys.md\ndocs/agents/domain.md\ndocs/agents/issue-tracker.md\ndocs/agents/triage-labels.md\ndocs/handoff/.gitkeep\ndocs/handoff/01_t03-done-next-t04_20261014.md\ndocs/handoffs/_TEMPLATE.md\ndocs/manual_iphs400_mp2-web-cms_20260922.md\ndocs/manual_iphs400_mp2plus-web-cms_20261012.md\ndocs/mp2-grading-rubric_20260922.md\ndocs/mp2-setup_context-threshold-hook_20260922.md\ndocs/mp2plus-grading-rubric_20261012.md\ndocs/process/.gitkeep\ndocs/process/compaction-log.md\ndocs/screenshots/.gitkeep\nnotes/.gitkeep\nnotes/client-brief.md\nnotes/cms-field-notes.md\nnotes/research_cms-content-roles-publishing_20261014.md\nnotes/setup_check.md\nnotes/token-budget-plan.md\nnotes/usage-ledger.csv\npyproject.toml\nscripts/check_submission.py\nscripts/seed_demo.py\nscripts/usage_report.py\ntemplates/admin/accounts.html\ntemplates/admin/hello.html\ntemplates/admin/login.html\ntemplates/admin/post_form.html\ntemplates/admin/posts.html\ntemplates/base.html\ntemplates/public/home.html\ntests/conftest.py\ntests/test_ctx_guard.py\ntests/test_t00.py\ntests/test_t01_login.py\ntests/test_t02_accounts.py\ntests/test_t03_posts.py\ntests/test_usage_report.py\nuv.lock\n\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nT00 publishes a placeholder home page. As you build content types, extend\nrender_site() to write one file per published item. Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import settings\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    return Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    env = environment()\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n    (out / \"index.html\").write_text(\n        env.get_template(\"public/home.html\").render(\n            title=settings.SITE_TITLE, items=[], css_path=\"style.css\",\n            home_path=\"index.html\",\n        )\n    )\n    return out\n\"\"\"Content items: posts and pages share one shape (see CONTEXT.md).\n\nAn item has a kind (post or page), a title, a unique slug, a Markdown body, a\nstatus (draft or published), an author account and created/updated\ntimestamps. The slug is generated from the title and de-duplicated\n(\"practice-schedule\", \"practice-schedule-2\", ...); only admins set one by hand.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nimport unicodedata\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom datetime import UTC, datetime\nfrom enum import StrEnum\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import db\nfrom app.accounts import Account\n\n\nclass Kind(StrEnum):\n    POST = \"post\"\n    PAGE = \"page\"\n\n\nclass Status(StrEnum):\n    DRAFT = \"draft\"\n    PUBLISHED = \"published\"\n\n\nclass SlugTaken(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an admin sets a slug another item already uses.\"\"\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Item:\n    id: int\n    kind: Kind\n    title: str\n    slug: str\n    body: str\n    status: Status\n    author_id: int\n    author_email: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n\n\ndef can_change(account: Account, item: Item) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Admins change anything; editors change only posts they wrote.\"\"\"\n    return account.is_admin or (item.kind is Kind.POST\n                                and item.author_id == account.id)\n\n\ndef slugify(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"'Practice Schedule!' -> 'practice-schedule'; '' when nothing is left.\"\"\"\n    ascii_text = (unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKD\", text)\n                  .encode(\"ascii\", \"ignore\").decode())\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", ascii_text.lower()).strip(\"-\")\n\n\ndef _now() -> str:\n    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec=\"microseconds\")\n\n\n_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT items.*, accounts.email AS author_email\nFROM items JOIN accounts ON accounts.id = items.author_id\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _from_row(row) -> Item:\n    return Item(id=row[\"id\"], kind=Kind(row[\"kind\"]), title=row[\"title\"],\n                slug=row[\"slug\"], body=row[\"body\"], status=Status(row[\"status\"]),\n                author_id=row[\"author_id\"], author_email=row[\"author_email\"],\n                created_at=row[\"created_at\"], updated_at=row[\"updated_at\"])\n\n\ndef _unique_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, title: str, kind: Kind) -> str:\n    base = slugify(title) or kind.value\n    taken = {row[\"slug\"] for row in conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT slug FROM items WHERE slug = ? OR slug LIKE ?\",\n        (base, f\"{base}-%\"))}\n    slug, n = base, 2\n    while slug in taken:\n        slug, n = f\"{base}-{n}\", n + 1\n    return slug\n\n\ndef create_item(db_path: Path, kind: Kind, title: str, body: str,\n                author: Account) -> Item:\n    now = _now()\n    with db.connect(db_path) as conn:\n        cursor = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO items (kind, title, slug, body, author_id, created_at,\"\n            \" updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (kind, title, _unique_slug(conn, title, kind), body, author.id, now,\n             now),\n        )\n    return get_item(db_path, cursor.lastrowid)\n\n\ndef get_item(db_path: Path, item_id: int) -> Item | None:\n    with db.connect(db_path) as conn:\n        row = conn.execute(_SELECT + \"WHERE items.id = ?\", (item_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef list_items(db_path: Path, kind: Kind) -> list[Item]:\n    \"\"\"Newest first.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect(db_path) as conn:\n        rows = conn.execute(_SELECT + \"WHERE kind = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC,\"\n                            \" items.id DESC\", (kind,)).fetchall()\n    return [_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef update_item(db_path: Path, item_id: int, title: str, body: str,\n                slug: str | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Change title and body; change the slug too when one is given.\n\n    Raises SlugTaken if the new slug belongs to another item.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect(db_path) as conn:\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE items SET title = ?, body = ?, slug = COALESCE(?, slug),\"\n                \" updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                (title, body, slug, _now(), item_id),\n            )\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n        raise SlugTaken(slug) from exc\n\n\ndef delete_item(db_path: Path, item_id: int) -> None:\n    with db.connect(db_path) as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM items WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,))\n\"\"\"Posts: any logged-in account writes them; editors change only their own.\n\nEvery form here has two buttons, Preview and Save draft, sent as `action`.\nPreview re-shows the form with the sanitized, rendered Markdown and saves\nnothing. Editors get 403 on someone else's post, whether they follow a link\nor type the URL. Only admins may set a slug by hand; an editor's slug field,\nif sent anyway, is ignored.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import content\nfrom app.accounts import Account\nfrom app.content import Item, Kind\nfrom app.markdown import render_markdown\nfrom app.web import current_account, templates, verify_csrf\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/posts\", dependencies=[Depends(current_account)])\n\n\ndef _form(request: Request, me: Account, *, item: Item | None, title: str,\n          body: str, slug: str, error: str = \"\", preview: bool = False,\n          status_code: int = 200):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>{{ title }}</h1>\n  {% if items %}\n    <ul>{% for item in items %}<li><a href=\"{{ item.href }}\">{{ item.title }}</a></li>{% endfor %}</ul>\n  {% else %}\n    <p>Nothing published yet.</p>\n  {% endif %}\n{% endblock %}\n<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"en\">\n<head>\n  <meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n  <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">\n  <title>{% block title %}{{ title }}{% endblock %}</title>\n  <link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"{{ css_path | default('style.css') }}\">\n</head>\n<body>\n  <header><a href=\"{{ home_path | default('index.html') }}\">{{ title }}</a></header>\n  <main>{% block content %}{% endblock %}</main>\n  <footer><small>IPHS 400 Mini-Project #2</small></footer>\n</body>\n</html>\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <p><a href=\"{{ root(request) }}admin/posts\">Back to posts</a></p>\n  <h1>{{ \"Edit post\" if item else \"New post\" }}</h1>\n  {% if error %}<p role=\"alert\"><strong>{{ error }}</strong></p>{% endif %}\n\n  {% if item %}\n    <p>{{ item.status | capitalize }} by {{ item.author_email }}.\n      Created <time class=\"created\" datetime=\"{{ item.created_at }}\">{{ item.created_at | when }}</time>,\n      updated <time class=\"updated\" datetime=\"{{ item.updated_at }}\">{{ item.updated_at | when }}</time>.</p>\n  {% endif %}\n\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ root(request) }}admin/posts{% if item %}/{{ item.id }}{% endif %}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p><label>Title<br><input type=\"text\" name=\"title\" value=\"{{ post_title }}\" required></label></p>\n    {% if item and account.is_admin %}\n      <p><label>Slug<br><input type=\"text\" name=\"slug\" value=\"{{ slug }}\" required></label></p>\n    {% endif %}\n    <p><label>Body (Markdown)<br><textarea name=\"body\" rows=\"16\" cols=\"60\">{{ body }}</textarea></label></p>\n    <p>\n      <button type=\"submit\" name=\"action\" value=\"preview\">Preview</button>\n      <button type=\"submit\" name=\"action\" value=\"save\">Save draft</button>\n    </p>\n  </form>\n\n  {% if preview is not none %}\n    <h2>Preview</h2>\n    <section class=\"preview\">{{ preview | safe }}</section>\n  {% endif %}\n\n  {% if item %}\n    <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ root(request) }}admin/posts/{{ item.id }}/delete\">\n      <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n      <button type=\"submit\">Delete post</button>\n    </form>\n  {% endif %}\n{% endblock %}\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <p><a href=\"{{ root(request) }}admin\">Back to the console</a></p>\n  <h1>Posts</h1>\n  <p><a href=\"{{ root(request) }}admin/posts/new\">New post</a></p>\n\n  {% if posts %}\n  <table>\n    <thead><tr><th>Title</th><th>Status</th><th>Author</th><th>Updated</th></tr></thead>\n    <tbody>\n    {% for p in posts %}\n      <tr data-post-id=\"{{ p.id }}\" data-slug=\"{{ p.slug }}\">\n        <td>\n          {% if can_change(account, p) %}\n            <a href=\"{{ root(request) }}admin/posts/{{ p.id }}\">{{ p.title }}</a>\n          {% else %}\n            {{ p.title }}\n          {% endif %}\n        </td>\n        <td>{{ p.status | capitalize }}</td>\n        <td>{{ p.author_email }}</td>\n        <td><time datetime=\"{{ p.updated_at }}\">{{ p.updated_at | when }}</time></td>\n      </tr>\n    {% endfor %}\n    </tbody>\n  </table>\n  {% else %}\n    <p>No posts yet.</p>\n  {% endif %}\n{% endblock %}\n\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nThe admin console lives under /admin and needs a login (/login); the public\nsite answers at /. Routes live in their own modules under app/routes/ and are\nincluded here. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, settings\nfrom app.routes import accounts, auth, console, posts\nfrom app.web import LoginRequired, templates\n\n\ndef create_app(db_path: Path | None = None) -> FastAPI:\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n    app.state.db_path = db_path or settings.DATABASE_PATH\n    db.init(app.state.db_path)\n\n    # Signed session cookie that ends when the browser closes (shared laptop).\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                       session_cookie=\"cms_session\", max_age=None,\n                       same_site=\"lax\")\n\n    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n    def to_login(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"items\": []},\n        )\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(console.router)\n    app.include_router(accounts.router)\n    app.include_router(posts.router)\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n\"\"\"The SQLite database: one file, opened per operation.\n\nThe database is never committed (it is gitignored); scripts/seed_demo.py\nrebuilds it on a fresh clone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounts (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    password_hash TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    active        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0, 1))\n);\n\n-- Posts and pages share one table; kind drives navigation and permissions.\n-- Timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC strings, so they sort as text.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    kind       TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('post', 'page')),\n    title      TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    slug       TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    body       TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    status     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n                       CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n    author_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id),\n    created_at TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    updated_at TEXT    NOT NULL\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect(path: Path) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Open the database, commit on success, roll back on error, always close.\"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(path)\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON\")\n    try:\n        with conn:\n            yield conn\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef init(path: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Create the tables if they do not exist yet.\"\"\"\n    with connect(path) as conn:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n\"\"\"User-written Markdown -> safe HTML.\n\nEvery place that shows a post or page body (console preview, public site)\ngoes through render_markdown(), so nothing user-written reaches a browser\nunsanitized. {"parentUuid":"ba1a0422-2533-40eb-b8a6-8c934af0a7bc","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"ccfe1af8-1b6f-4bbb-ae51-d4f32feec672","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01LMGtSwZowwJ8PaUQE9mFex","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"What every console route shares: templates, CSRF, and who is logged in.\n\nThree dependencies do the guarding:\n\n  - `verify_csrf` goes on every state-changing (POST) route. It rejects the\n    request with 403 unless the form's csrf_token matches the session's.\n  - `current_account` goes on every console route (the console router in\n    app/routes/console.py applies it to all of them). Someone who isn't\n    logged in, or whose account was deactivated, is sent to /login.\n  - `require_admin` goes on admin-only routes. It does what `current_account`\n    does, then refuses editors with 403, so a typed URL is denied, not just\n    a hidden link.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hmac\nimport secrets\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import accounts, settings\nfrom app.accounts import Account\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by `current_account`; create_app() turns it into a redirect.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The session's CSRF token, created on first use. Put it in every form.\"\"\"\n    if \"csrf\" not in request.session:\n        request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return request.session[\"csrf\"]\n\n\ndef root(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative path from this page back to the site root (\"\", \"../\", ...).\n\n    Console links are written as {{ root(request) }}admin/accounts, so they stay\n    relative yet still work when a form re-renders a page at a deeper URL such\n    as /admin/accounts/5/role.\n    \"\"\"\n    return \"../\" * (request.url.path.count(\"/\") - 1)\n\n\ndef when(timestamp: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"An ISO UTC timestamp as the console shows it: '2026-10-14 18:05 UTC'.\"\"\"\n    return f\"{timestamp[:16].replace('T', ' ')} UTC\"\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"root\"] = root\ntemplates.env.filters[\"when\"] = when\n\n\ndef verify_csrf(request: Request, csrf_token: str = Form(\"\")) -> None:\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\", \"\")\n    if not (expected and hmac.compare_digest(expected, csrf_token)):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Invalid or missing CSRF token.\")\n\n\ndef current_account(request: Request) -> Account:\n    account_id = request.session.get(\"account_id\")\n    account = (accounts.get_account(request.app.state.db_path, account_id)\n               if account_id is not None else None)\n    if account is None or not account.active:\n        request.session.clear()\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return account\n\n\ndef require_admin(account: Account = Depends(current_account)) -> Account:\n    if not account.is_admin:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Only admins can do that.\")\n    return account\n\"\"\"Demo data: one admin and one editor, so the console is usable straight away.\n\nscripts/seed_demo.py calls this with passwords from the environment; the tests\ncall it with fixed ones. Running it again leaves existing accounts alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import accounts, db\nfrom app.accounts import Role\n\nDEMO_EMAILS = {\n    Role.ADMIN: \"admin@example.test\",\n    Role.EDITOR: \"editor@example.test\",\n}\n\n\ndef seed_demo(db_path: Path, admin_password: str, editor_password: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Create the demo accounts that do not exist yet; return the emails created.\"\"\"\n    db.init(db_path)\n    created = []\n    for role, password in ((Role.ADMIN, admin_password), (Role.EDITOR, editor_password)):\n        email = DEMO_EMAILS[role]\n        if accounts.find_by_email(db_path, email) is None:\n            accounts.create_account(db_path, email, password, role)\n            created.append(email)\n    return created\n                         body=\"*unsaved* body\", action=\"preview\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"<em>unsaved</em>\" in response.text\n    assert \"saved body\" in c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\").text\n    assert \"unsaved\" not in c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\").text\n\n\n# --- drafts stay private -----------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_drafts_never_reach_the_public_site(client_as, post_form, client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Until T04, render_site() reads no content at all, so this guards the\n    rule rather than proving it; T04 adds published posts beside the draft.\"\"\"\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    new_post(post_form, client_as(\"editor\"), \"Secret draft title\", \"secret body\")\n    assert \"Secret draft title\" not in client.get(\"/\").text\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    for f in out.rglob(\"*\"):\n        if f.is_file():\n            text = f.read_text()\n            assert \"Secret draft title\" not in text and \"secret body\" not in text\n\n\n# --- CSRF and login ----------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_post_forms_carry_a_csrf_token(client_as, post_form):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    post_id = new_post(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\")\n    for url in (\"/admin/posts/new\", f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\"):\n        page = c.get(url).text\n        assert page.count('method=\"post\"') >= 1\n\"\"\"T00: the walking skeleton. {"parentUuid":"4e5729e2-78b2-46b1-8114-4a45dd5b9ea8","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg4HpGrH1jUf9ijVBwUS1","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01VSL2ZJXTiDwDuTS3Ud8HFk","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t04_publish.py","content":"\"\"\"T04: published posts appear on the public site (issue #5).\n\nTwo seams. Over HTTP, the console publishes, unpublishes, edits and deletes;\na site update writes into `site_dir` (the test app's site/). Rendering tests\ncall render_site() into a temporary directory and read the files it wrote.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport shutil\n\nimport pytest\nfrom conftest import DEMO_ACCOUNTS\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\nfrom test_t03_posts import new_post, slug_of\n\nfrom app.publish import render_site\n\n\ndef publish_new(post_form, c: TestClient, title: str, body: str = \"\") -> int:\n    \"\"\"Write and publish a post in one click; return its id.\"\"\"\n    response = post_form(c, \"/admin/posts\", title=title, body=body,\n                         action=\"publish\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    return int(response.headers[\"location\"].rsplit(\"/\", 1)[1])\n\n\ndef site_text(out) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Every file under the site, concatenated.\"\"\"\n    return \"\\n\".join(f.read_text() for f in sorted(out.rglob(\"*\")) if f.is_file())\n\n\ndef post_file(out, slug: str):\n    return out / \"posts\" / f\"{slug}.html\"\n\n\n# --- the editor screen -------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_save_draft_and_publish_sit_side_by_side(client_as):\n    page = client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/posts/new\").text\n    assert re.search(r'<button[^>]*value=\"save\"[^>]*>Save draft</button>\\s*'\n                     r'<button[^>]*value=\"publish\"[^>]*>Publish</button>', page)\n\n\ndef test_publish_takes_one_click_and_the_post_reaches_the_site(\n        client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = publish_new(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\", \"- Mon 3pm, range\")\n    assert \"Published\" in c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\").text\n    home = (site_dir / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert \"Practice schedule\" in home\n    page = post_file(site_dir, slug_of(c, post_id)).read_text()\n    assert \"<li>Mon 3pm, range</li>\" in page\n\n\ndef test_publishing_an_existing_draft(client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = new_post(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\", \"draft text\")\n    assert not site_dir.exists()\n    response = post_form(c, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\", title=\"Practice schedule\",\n                         body=\"final text\", action=\"publish\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert \"final text\" in post_file(site_dir, slug_of(c, post_id)).read_text()\n\n\ndef test_a_published_post_offers_unpublish_not_publish(client_as, post_form):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{publish_new(post_form, c, 'Recap')}\").text\n    assert \"Unpublish\" in page\n    assert 'value=\"publish\"' not in page\n\n\ndef test_publish_without_a_title_is_refused_and_nothing_is_written(\n        client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = post_form(c, \"/admin/posts\", title=\" \", body=\"kept\",\n                         action=\"publish\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert \"kept\" in response.text\n    assert not site_dir.exists()\n\n\n# --- which changes run a site update -----------------------------------------\n\ndef test_saving_a_draft_runs_no_site_update(client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = new_post(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\")\n    post_form(c, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\", title=\"Practice schedule v2\",\n              body=\"\", action=\"save\")\n    assert not site_dir.exists()\n\n\ndef test_deleting_a_draft_runs_no_site_update(client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    publish_new(post_form, c, \"Already live\")\n    shutil.rmtree(site_dir)\n    draft_id = new_post(post_form, c, \"Never live\")\n    post_form(c, f\"/admin/posts/{draft_id}/delete\")\n    assert not site_dir.exists()\n\n\ndef test_editing_a_published_post_updates_the_site(client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = publish_new(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\", \"Mon 3pm\")\n    response = post_form(c, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\", title=\"Practice schedule\",\n                         body=\"Tue 4pm\", action=\"save\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    page = post_file(site_dir, slug_of(c, post_id)).read_text()\n    assert \"Tue 4pm\" in page and \"Mon 3pm\" not in page\n    assert \"Published\" in c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\").text\n\n\ndef test_unpublishing_returns_the_post_to_draft_and_removes_it(\n        client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = publish_new(post_form, c, \"Posted by mistake\", \"oops\")\n    slug = slug_of(c, post_id)\n    response = post_form(c, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/unpublish\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert \"Draft\" in c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\").text\n    assert not post_file(site_dir, slug).exists()\n    assert \"Posted by mistake\" not in site_text(site_dir)\n\n\ndef test_deleting_a_published_post_removes_it_from_the_site(\n        client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = publish_new(post_form, c, \"Old recap\", \"text\")\n    slug = slug_of(c, post_id)\n    post_form(c, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/delete\")\n    assert not post_file(site_dir, slug).exists()\n    assert \"Old recap\" not in site_text(site_dir)\n\n\n# --- who may publish and unpublish -------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_admin_can_unpublish_an_editors_post(client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    post_id = publish_new(post_form, client_as(\"editor\"), \"Captain's post\")\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert post_form(admin, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/unpublish\").status_code == 303\n    assert \"Captain's post\" not in site_text(site_dir)\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", [\"/unpublish\", \"\"])\ndef test_editor_cannot_publish_or_unpublish_someone_elses_post(\n        client_as, post_form, site_dir, path):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    post_id = publish_new(post_form, admin, \"Qualifying results\", \"1. Sam\")\n    response = post_form(client_as(\"editor\"), f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}{path}\",\n                         title=\"Hacked\", body=\"\", action=\"publish\")\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n    assert \"Qualifying results\" in site_text(site_dir)\n    assert \"Hacked\" not in site_text(site_dir)\n\n\ndef test_unpublish_needs_a_csrf_token(client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = publish_new(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\")\n    response = c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/unpublish\", data={},\n                      follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n    assert \"Practice schedule\" in site_text(site_dir)\n\n\n# --- what the site update writes ---------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_home_lists_published_posts_newest_first_with_author_and_date(\n        client_as, post_form, db_path, tmp_path):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    publish_new(post_form, c, \"Older recap\")\n    publish_new(post_form, c, \"Newer practice schedule\")\n    home = (render_site(tmp_path / \"out\", db_path) / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert home.index(\"Newer practice schedule\") < home.index(\"Older recap\")\n    author = DEMO_ACCOUNTS[\"editor\"][\"email\"].split(\"@\")[0]\n    assert home.count(author) >= 2\n    assert home.count(\"<time datetime=\") >= 2\n\n\ndef test_post_page_shows_author_and_created_and_updated_times(\n        client_as, post_form, db_path, tmp_path):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = publish_new(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\")\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"out\", db_path)\n    page = post_file(out, slug_of(c, post_id)).read_text()\n    assert DEMO_ACCOUNTS[\"editor\"][\"email\"].split(\"@\")[0] in page\n    assert 'class=\"created\"' in page and 'class=\"updated\"' in page\n\n\ndef test_home_links_to_each_post_page(client_as, post_form, db_path, tmp_path):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    slug = slug_of(c, publish_new(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\"))\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"out\", db_path)\n    assert f'href=\"posts/{slug}.html\"' in (out / \"index.html\").read_text()\n\n\ndef test_drafts_never_reach_the_output(client_as, post_form, db_path, tmp_path):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    publish_new(post_form, c, \"Live post\", \"live body\")\n    new_post(post_form, c, \"Secret draft title\", \"secret body\")\n    text = site_text(render_site(tmp_path / \"out\", db_path))\n    assert \"Live post\" in text\n    assert \"Secret draft title\" not in text and \"secret body\" not in text\n    assert len(list((tmp_path / \"out\" / \"posts\").iterdir())) == 1\n\n\ndef test_markdown_is_sanitized_before_it_is_written(\n        client_as, post_form, db_path, tmp_path):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    publish_new(post_form, c, \"Pasted snippet <b>bold</b>\",\n                \"<script>alert(1)</script>\\n\\n<a href=\\\"x\\\" onclick=\\\"evil()\\\">x</a>\"\n                \"\\n\\n[link](javascript:alert(2))\")\n    text = site_text(render_site(tmp_path / \"out\", db_path)).lower()\n    assert \"<script\" not in text\n    assert \"onclick\" not in text\n    assert \"javascript:\" not in text\n    assert \"<b>bold</b>\" not in text\n\n\ndef test_every_href_and_src_is_relative(client_as, post_form, db_path, tmp_path):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    publish_new(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\", \"[Golfstat](https://golfstat.com)\")\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"out\", db_path)\n    for f in out.rglob(\"*.html\"):\n        html = f.read_text()\n        assert not re.search(r'(?:href|src)=\"/', html), f\n    page = next((out / \"posts\").glob(\"*.html\")).read_text()\n    assert 'href=\"../style.css\"' in page and 'href=\"../index.html\"' in page\n\n\ndef test_cms_publish_uses_the_same_site_update(client_as, post_form, db_path,\n                                                tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    from app import settings\n    from app.cli import main\n\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    slug = slug_of(c, publish_new(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\"))\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"DATABASE_PATH\", db_path)\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"SITE\", tmp_path / \"cli-site\")\n    assert main([\"publish\"]) == 0\n    assert post_file(tmp_path / \"cli-site\", Rendering tests\ncall render_site() into a temporary directory and read the files it wrote.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport shutil\n\nimport pytest\nfrom conftest import DEMO_ACCOUNTS\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\nfrom test_t03_posts import new_post, slug_of\n\nfrom app.publish import render_site\n\n\ndef publish_new(post_form, c: TestClient,      action=\"publish\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    return int(response.headers[\"location\"].rsplit(\"/\", 1)[1])\n\n\ndef site_text(out) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Every file under the site, concatenated.\"\"\"\n    return \"\\n\".join(f.read_text() for f in sorted(out.rglob(\"*\")) if f.is_file())\n\n\ndef post_file(out, slug: str):\n    return out / \"posts\" / f\"{slug}.html\"\n\n\n# --- the editor screen -------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_save_draft_and_publish_sit_side_by_side(client_as):\n    page = client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/posts/new\").text\n    assert re.search(r'<button[^>]*value=\"save\"[^>]*>Save draft</button>\\s*'\n                     r'<button[^>]*value=\"publish\"[^>]*>Publish</button>', page)\n\n\ndef test_publish_takes_one_click_and_the_post_reaches_the_site(\n        client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = publish_new(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\", \"- Mon 3pm, range\")\n    assert \"Published\" in c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\").text\n    home = (site_dir / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert \"Practice schedule\" in home\n    page = post_file(site_dir, slug_of(c, post_id)).read_text()\n    assert \"<li>Mon 3pm, range</li>\" in page\n\n\ndef test_publishing_an_existing_draft(client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = new_post(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\", \"draft text\")\n    assert not site_dir.exists()\n    response = post_form(c, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\", title=\"Practice schedule\",\n                         body=\"final text\", action=\"publish\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert \"final text\" in post_file(site_dir, slug_of(c, post_id)).read_text()\n\n\ndef test_a_published_post_offers_unpublish_not_publish(client_as, post_form):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{publish_new(post_form, c, 'Recap')}\").text\n    assert \"Unpublish\" in page\n    assert 'value=\"publish\"' not in page\n\n\ndef test_publish_without_a_title_is_refused_and_nothing_is_written(\n        client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = post_form(c, \"/admin/posts\", title=\" \", body=\"kept\",\n                         action=\"publish\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert \"kept\" in response.text\n    assert not site_dir.exists()\n\n\n# --- which changes run a site update -----------------------------------------\n\ndef test_saving_a_draft_runs_no_site_update(client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = new_post(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\")\n    post_form(c, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\", title=\"Practice schedule v2\",\n              body=\"\", action=\"save\")\n    assert not site_dir.exists()\n\n\ndef test_deleting_a_draft_runs_no_site_update(client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    publish_new(post_form, c, \"Already live\")\n    shutil.rmtree(site_dir)\n    draft_id = new_post(post_form, c, \"Never live\")\n    post_form(c, f\"/admin/posts/{draft_id}/delete\")\n    assert not site_dir.exists()\n\n\ndef test_editing_a_published_post_updates_the_site(client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = publish_new(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\", \"Mon 3pm\")\n    response = post_form(c, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\", title=\"Practice schedule\",\n                         body=\"Tue 4pm\", action=\"save\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    page = post_file(site_dir, slug_of(c, post_id)).read_text()\n    assert \"Tue 4pm\" in page and \"Mon 3pm\" not in page\n    assert \"Published\" in c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\").text\n\n\ndef test_unpublishing_returns_the_post_to_draft_and_removes_it(\n        client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = publish_new(post_form, c, \"Posted by mistake\", \"oops\")\n    slug = slug_of(c, post_id)\n    response = post_form(c, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/unpublish\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert \"Draft\" in c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\").text\n    assert not post_file(site_dir, slug).exists()\n    assert \"Posted by mistake\" not in site_text(site_dir)\n\n\ndef test_deleting_a_published_post_removes_it_from_the_site(\n        client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = publish_new(post_form, c, \"Old recap\", \"text\")\n    slug = slug_of(c, post_id)\n    post_form(c, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/delete\")\n    assert not post_file(site_dir, slug).exists()\n    assert \"Old recap\" not in site_text(site_dir)\n\n\n# --- who may publish and unpublish -------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_admin_can_unpublish_an_editors_post(client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    post_id = publish_new(post_form, client_as(\"editor\"), \"Captain's post\")\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert post_form(admin, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/unpublish\").status_code == 303\n    assert \"Captain's post\" not in site_text(site_dir)\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", [\"/unpublish\", \"\"])\ndef test_editor_cannot_publish_or_unpublish_someone_elses_post(\n        client_as, post_form, site_dir, client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = publish_new(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\")\n    response = c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/unpublish\", data={},\n   assert DEMO_ACCOUNTS[\"editor\"][\"email\"].split(\"@\")[0] in page\n    assert 'class=\"created\"' in page and 'class=\"updated\"' in page\n\n\ndef test_home_links_to_each_post_page(client_as, post_form, db_path, tmp_path):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    slug = slug_of(c, publish_new(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\"))\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"out\", db_path)\n    assert publish_new(post_form, c, \"Live post\", \"live body\")\n    new_post(post_form, c, \"Secret draft title\", \"secret body\")\n    text = site_text(render_site(tmp_path / \"out\", db_path))\n    assert test_markdown_is_sanitized_before_it_is_written(\n        client_as, post_form, db_path, tmp_path):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    publish_new(post_form, c, \"Pasted snippet <b>bold</b>\",\n                \"<script>alert(1)</script>\\n\\n<a href=\\\"x\\\" onclick=\\\"evil()\\\">x</a>\"\n                \"\\n\\n[link](javascript:alert(2))\")\n    text = site_text(render_site(tmp_path / test_every_href_and_src_is_relative(client_as, post_form, db_path, tmp_path):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    publish_new(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\", Deploying arrives in T07 (ADR-004), inside update_site().\n\nTwo rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import content, settings\nfrom app.content import Kind, Status\nfrom app.markdown import render_markdown\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader a { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n.byline { color: GrayText; font-size: 0.9rem; }\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef byline(email: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The author's name on the public site: the part of the email before @.\n\n    The full email is never published, so readers can't harvest it.\n    \"\"\"\n    return email.split(\"@\", 1)[0]\n\n\ndef date(timestamp: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"An ISO UTC timestamp as readers see it: 'Oct 14, 2026'.\"\"\"\n    return datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp).strftime(\"%b %d, %Y\")\n\n\ndef environment() -> Environment:\n    env = Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n    env.filters[\"byline\"] = byline\n    env.filters[\"date\"] = date\n    return env\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None, db_path: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Rebuild `out` from scratch with every published post in `db_path`.\n\n    A database that doesn't exist yet (a fresh clone) renders an empty site.\n    \"\"\"\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    db_path = db_path or settings.DATABASE_PATH\n    posts = (content.list_items(db_path, Kind.POST, Status.PUBLISHED)\n             if db_path.exists() else [])\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    (out / \"posts\").mkdir(parents=True)\n    env = environment()\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n    (out / \"index.html\").write_text(\n        env.get_template(\"public/home.html\").render(\n            title=settings.SITE_TITLE, posts=posts, css_path=\"style.css\",\n            home_path=\"index.html\",\n        )\n    )\n    post_page = env.get_template(\"public/post.html\")\n    for post in posts:\n        (out / \"posts\" / f\"{post.slug}.html\").write_text(\n            post_page.render(\n                title=settings.SITE_TITLE, post=post,\n                body=render_markdown(post.body),\n                css_path=\"../style.css\", home_path=\"../index.html\",\n            )\n        )\n    return out\n\n\ndef update_site(db_path: Path, out: Path) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Run a site update after a change to published content.\"\"\"\n    return render_site(out, Rendering tests\ncall render_site() into a temporary directory and read the files it wrote.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport shutil\n\nimport pytest\nfrom conftest import DEMO_ACCOUNTS\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\nfrom test_t03_posts import new_post, slug_of\n\nfrom app.publish import render_site\n\n\ndef publish_new(post_form, c: TestClient, title: str, body: str = \"\") -> int:\n    \"\"\"Write and publish a post in one click; return its id.\"\"\"\n    response = post_form(c, \"/admin/posts\", title=title, body=body,\n                         action=\"publish\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    return int(response.headers[\"location\"].rsplit(\"/\", 1)[1])\n\n\ndef site_text(out) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Every file under the site, concatenated.\"\"\"\n    return \"\\n\".join(f.read_text() for f in sorted(out.rglob(\"*\")) if f.is_file())\n\n\ndef post_file(out, slug: str):\n    return out / \"posts\" / f\"{slug}.html\"\n\n\n# --- the editor screen -------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_save_draft_and_publish_sit_side_by_side(client_as):\n    page = client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/posts/new\").text\n    assert re.search(r'<button[^>]*value=\"save\"[^>]*>Save draft</button>\\s*'\n                     r'<button[^>]*value=\"publish\"[^>]*>Publish</button>', page)\n\n\ndef test_publish_takes_one_click_and_the_post_reaches_the_site(\n        client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = publish_new(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\", \"- Mon 3pm, range\")\n    assert \"Published\" in c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\").text\n    home = (site_dir / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert \"Practice schedule\" in home\n    page = post_file(site_dir, slug_of(c, post_id)).read_text()\n    assert \"<li>Mon 3pm, range</li>\" in page\n\n\ndef test_publishing_an_existing_draft(client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = new_post(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\", \"draft text\")\n    assert not site_dir.exists()\n    response = post_form(c, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\", title=\"Practice schedule\",\n                         body=\"final text\", action=\"publish\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert \"final text\" in post_file(site_dir, slug_of(c, post_id)).read_text()\n\n\ndef test_a_published_post_offers_unpublish_not_publish(client_as, post_form):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{publish_new(post_form, c, 'Recap')}\").text\n    assert \"Unpublish\" in page\n    assert 'value=\"publish\"' not in page\n\n\ndef test_publish_without_a_title_is_refused_and_nothing_is_written(\n        client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    response = post_form(c, \"/admin/posts\", title=\" \", body=\"kept\",\n                         action=\"publish\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert \"kept\" in response.text\n    assert not site_dir.exists()\n\n\n# --- which changes run a site update -----------------------------------------\n\ndef test_saving_a_draft_runs_no_site_update(client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = new_post(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\")\n    post_form(c, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\", title=\"Practice schedule v2\",\n              body=\"\", action=\"save\")\n    assert not site_dir.exists()\n\n\ndef test_deleting_a_draft_runs_no_site_update(client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    publish_new(post_form, c, \"Already live\")\n    shutil.rmtree(site_dir)\n    draft_id = new_post(post_form, c, \"Never live\")\n    post_form(c, f\"/admin/posts/{draft_id}/delete\")\n    assert not site_dir.exists()\n\n\ndef test_editing_a_published_post_updates_the_site(client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = publish_new(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\", \"Mon 3pm\")\n    response = post_form(c, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\", title=\"Practice schedule\",\n                         body=\"Tue 4pm\", action=\"save\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    page = post_file(site_dir, slug_of(c, post_id)).read_text()\n    assert \"Tue 4pm\" in page and \"Mon 3pm\" not in page\n    assert \"Published\" in c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\").text\n\n\ndef test_unpublishing_returns_the_post_to_draft_and_removes_it(\n        client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = publish_new(post_form, c, \"Posted by mistake\", \"oops\")\n    slug = slug_of(c, post_id)\n    response = post_form(c, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/unpublish\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert \"Draft\" in c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\").text\n    assert not post_file(site_dir, slug).exists()\n    assert \"Posted by mistake\" not in site_text(site_dir)\n\n\ndef test_deleting_a_published_post_removes_it_from_the_site(\n        client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = publish_new(post_form, c, \"Old recap\", \"text\")\n    slug = slug_of(c, post_id)\n    post_form(c, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/delete\")\n    assert not post_file(site_dir, slug).exists()\n    assert \"Old recap\" not in site_text(site_dir)\n\n\n# --- who may publish and unpublish -------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_admin_can_unpublish_an_editors_post(client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    post_id = publish_new(post_form, client_as(\"editor\"), \"Captain's post\")\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert post_form(admin, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/unpublish\").status_code == 303\n    assert \"Captain's post\" not in site_text(site_dir)\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", [\"/unpublish\", \"\"])\ndef test_editor_cannot_publish_or_unpublish_someone_elses_post(\n        client_as, post_form, site_dir, path):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    post_id = publish_new(post_form, admin, \"Qualifying results\", \"1. Sam\")\n    response = post_form(client_as(\"editor\"), f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}{path}\",\n                         title=\"Hacked\", body=\"\", action=\"publish\")\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n    assert \"Qualifying results\" in site_text(site_dir)\n    assert \"Hacked\" not in site_text(site_dir)\n\n\ndef test_unpublish_needs_a_csrf_token(client_as, post_form, site_dir):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = publish_new(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\")\n    response = c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/unpublish\", data={},\n                      follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n    assert \"Practice schedule\" in site_text(site_dir)\n\n\n# --- what the site update writes client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = publish_new(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\")\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"out\", db_path)\n    page = post_file(out, slug_of(c, post_id)).read_text()\n    assert DEMO_ACCOUNTS[\"editor\"][\"email\"].split(\"@\")[0] in page\n    assert 'class=\"created\"' in page and 'class=\"updated\"' in page\n\n\ndef test_home_links_to_each_post_page(client_as, post_form, db_path, tmp_path):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    slug = slug_of(c, publish_new(post_form, c, \"Practice schedule\"))\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"out\", db_path)\n    assert publish_new(post_form, c, \"Live post\", \"live body\")\n    new_post(post_form, c, \"Secret draft title\", \"secret body\")\n    text = site_text(render_site(tmp_path / \"out\", db_path))\n    assert test_markdown_is_sanitized_before_it_is_written(\n        client_as, post_form, db_path, tmp_path):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    publish_new(post_form, c, \"Pasted snippet <b>bold</b>\",\n {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"3fe5d8d2-454b-407f-92b3-5945b5c07e19","hash":"854e568a67c8ca6f4d4705e535f977001a228358a51c0c181508ede2667bbef9","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"toolu_019VWMRRrrMWuqKydba3eeM5","content":"Launching skill: mattpocock-skills:code-review"},{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /home/refiv/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.2.3/skills/engineering/code-review\n\nTwo-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:\n\n- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?\n- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?\n\nBoth axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.\n\nThe issue tracker should have been provided to you. If `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` is missing, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\n\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\n\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\n\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\n\n### 2. Identify the spec source\n\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\n\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\n\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\n\nAnything in the repo that documents how code should be written, such as `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`.\n\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\n\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\n\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\n\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\n\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\n\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The full diff command and commit list.\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\n\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The diff command and commit list.\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\n\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\n\n### 5. Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\n\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: Review uncommitted changes since HEAD (da86a43) for ticket T04, issue #5; spec is issue #1."}]}}

{"parentUuid":"c28553c1-0c17-43c1-b570-1a0b03a126c5","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"ccfe1af8-1b6f-4bbb-ae51-d4f32feec672","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /home/refiv/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.2.3/skills/engineering/code-review\n\nTwo-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:\n\n- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?\n- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?\n\nBoth axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.\n\nThe issue tracker should have been provided to you. If `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` is missing, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\n\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\n\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\n\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\n\n### 2. Identify the spec source\n\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\n\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\n\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\n\nAnything in the repo that documents how code should be written, such as `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`.\n\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\n\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\n\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\n\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\n\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\n\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The full diff command and commit list.\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\n\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The diff command and commit list.\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\n\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\n\n### 5. Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\n\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: Review uncommitted changes since HEAD (da86a43) for ticket T04, issue #5; spec is issue #1."}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"05e0115e-7407-4824-9f6c-441ad53d1127","timestamp":"2026-10-15T15:55:39.045Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_019VWMRRrrMWuqKydba3eeM5","session_id":"3fe5d8d2-454b-407f-92b3-5945b5c07e19","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"3fe5d8d2-454b-407f-92b3-5945b5c07e19","version":"2.1.300","gitBranch":"main"}

The report follows:\n  **T04 spec conformance review: uncommitted diff on da86a43**\n  \n  Overall, every T04 acceptance criterion has matching code and a test. I found no outright failure. The findings below are partial matches, judgement calls, and one design choice that will make T07 harder.\n  \n  **(a) Missing or partial**\n  \n  1. **`cms publish` does not call `update_site`.** Spec: \"`cms publish` and `cms deploy` remain for the Webmaster. They call the same site update module.\" Ticket: \"`cms publish` uses the same site update module\". `app/cli.py` was not touched and still calls `render_site()`. That meets the \"same module\" wording. But once T07 adds the deploy inside `update_site()`, the console and the CLI will take different paths through it, so decide now which entry point the CLI calls.\n  2. **The console's public home at `/` still shows no posts.** `app/main.py` `public_home` passes `\"posts\": []`, so it always says \"Nothing published yet\" even after a publish. No criterion requires this page, but it contradicts story 39 (\"on the website without any extra step\") for anyone previewing locally.\n  \n  **(b) Scope creep (not asked for)**\n  \n  3. **The author's name is the part of the email before `@`** (`publish.byline`). Spec: \"posts carry my name\" and \"with author and date\". There is no name field, so this is a new product decision. Record it in an ADR or `CONTEXT.md` rather than leaving it only in a docstring.\n  4. **Published posts get a new button.** On a published post the form shows \"Save and update site\" instead of \"Save draft\", and Publish is hidden. The criterion \"Save draft and Publish side by side\" is met only for drafts. The behaviour is reasonable but goes beyond the spec, and the new label is not in the glossary. `CONTEXT.md` says to avoid \"publish\" for the site-update step, and this label is close to that.\n  5. **`create_app(site_dir=...)` is a new seam.** The spec's seam is \"The deployer is injected through `create_app()`\". Adding `site_dir` is harmless but was not specified.\n  \n  **(c) Implemented but looks wrong**\n  \n  6. **The change is committed before the site update, which works against T07.** Spec: \"The change is staged, the site is rebuilt from the would-be state, and the deploy is attempted. Only after a successful deploy is the change committed.\" Every route writes to the database first and then calls `update_site()`. `render_site` can only read committed rows from `db_path`. So T07 will need to restructure this (a shared transaction, or rendering from an in-memory would-be state), not just add code. Also, if rendering fails today, the database is already changed: \"Published\" stays set while `site/` is stale or missing, because `render_site` has already deleted `out` with `rmtree`.\n  7. **\"Newest first\" sorts by `created_at`, not by publish time.** Ticket: \"published posts, newest first\". A draft written Monday and published Friday is listed below a post created Tuesday, and the home page shows the created date. Whether that matches \"newest\" is debatable, and story 46 (\"listed newest first\") assumes readers see recency. Worth an explicit decision.\n  \n  Everything else matches the ticket:\n  - Unpublish follows the permission rules (editors own posts, admins any) and needs a CSRF token.\n  - Draft-only saves and deletes never run a site update.\n  - Only published posts are written.\n  - Markdown is sanitized and titles are escaped.\n  - All paths are relative (`../style.css`).\n  - Rendering tests call `render_site` into `tmp_path`.\n</agent-message>"}

No criterion requires this page, but it contradicts story 39 (\"on the website without any extra step\") for anyone previewing locally.\n  \n  **(b) Scope creep (not asked for)**\n  \n  3. **The author's name is the part of the email before `@`** (`publish.byline`). Spec: \"posts carry my name\" and \"with author and date\". There is no name field, so this is a new product decision. Record it in an ADR or `CONTEXT.md` rather than leaving it only in a docstring.\n  4. **Published posts get a new button.** On a published post the form shows \"Save and update site\" instead of \"Save draft\", and Publish is hidden. The criterion \"Save draft and Publish side by side\" is met only for drafts. The behaviour is reasonable but goes beyond the spec, and the new label is not in the glossary. `CONTEXT.md` says to avoid \"publish\" for the site-update step, and this label is close to that.\n  5. **`create_app(site_dir=...)` is a new seam.** The spec's seam is \"The deployer is injected through `create_app()`\". So T07 will need to restructure this (a shared transaction, or rendering from an in-memory would-be state), not just add code. Also, if rendering fails today, the database is already changed: \"Published\" stays set while `site/` is stale or missing, because `render_site` has already deleted `out` with `rmtree`.\n  7. **\"Newest first\" sorts by `created_at`, not by publish time.** Ticket: \"published posts, newest first\".
